# docs/images/source-am-dsb.png — the AM-DSB source, mid-burst.
#
# Regenerated by scripts/regen-docs-images.sh.  The still's label is this file's
# basename, and that is what names the PNG; the two must not drift apart.
#
# `size`/`scale` are what make every README image the same 2400x1656: the
# interactive window's own 1200x828, at Retina density.

set run.size 1200x828
set run.scale 2
set run.duration 15

0.00  source AM DSB
0.50  key N                  # built-in audio Morse -> Voice: a modulated
                             # spectrum rather than a keyed tone
1.00  key D                  # decode bar -> Di

14.00 still source-am-dsb    # ~13.5 s into the burst — late enough that the
                             # waterfall has filled and peak hold has settled,
                             # and well before the 7 s gap
